_comment: Reference/example only - this file is NOT loaded directly by the service (it has no Signature). Edit a copy, then sign it with the operator's policy-signing key (Aegis.Gui's Policy & Autonomy tab, or scripts/New-PolicySigningKey.ps1 + your own signing call) before applying it via SetPolicy. The service always falls back to its safe built-in default (auto-containment OFF, human approval required for every high-impact action) if no verifiable signed policy is found - see docs/OPERATIONS.md.
